title: 第1618章 冤魂矿洞
slug: 顶级奸商无敌从贩卖军火开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

湿婆教的势力范围很广。

多都城也是湿婆教管辖范围。

本来湿婆教和大宁王朝打的不可开交，结果大商来了，天使领域也来了。

湿婆教主想以几座城和一个妹的代价让大商帮自己。

结果大商和天使领域打的不可开交，压根没空帮他们。

湿婆教主本想在这场战争中捞点好处。

可就在昨天，多都城城郊坍塌，露出一个尘封无尽岁月的矿洞。

有湿婆教的玩家进入后发现8重天BOSS。

8重天BOSS，那可是现在最值钱的BOSS。

湿婆教想暗中打掉。

但是这样的消息，凭湿婆教如此松散的管理，怎么可能守住秘密。

第一时间就传到林风耳朵里。

剑不凡就在附近，和林风汇合后，来到多都城。

【老大。。为什么不叫更多人？】

来到多都城后，剑不凡发现人太多了。

好多渡硬国玩家都朝那方向走。

他们甚至都没有任何避讳，都在商谈矿洞的事情。

【不是。。渡硬国这么没秘密的吗？】

林风也傻了：【咳咳，本来想低调点，可人家渡硬国低调不起来。】

【啧啧，在渡硬国搞情报真容易！】

【甭废话，泄露就泄露吧。。8重天BOSS不是那么好对付的，我们先去探探路。】

8重天是最值钱的BOSS，可这天下能打过8重天BOSS的没几个。

【不知道是不是兽形的，万一是人形的，一切都是白搭。】

【怎么会是人形的，人形的都在国家首都待着呢。】

【跟着去看看就知道了。】

林风和剑不凡都穿着隐匿斗篷，在人群中，朝矿洞方向走去。

多都城外的山脉，都是50级左右区域。

大多数玩家的等级也都在50级，就这么点等级，乌泱泱的人，居然要去杀8重天。

【我们渡硬国别的没有，就是人多。】

【没错，不管多强的BOSS，我们人海战术杀了它，再将它的战利品奉送给湿婆教，得神庇佑。】

【得神庇佑。】

看着他们兴奋的样子，真以为他们是来打BOSS的。

直到刚进入山脉范围，有一头70级的BOSS跳出来，直接灭了他们。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The sphere of influence of Shivaism is very wide.

Dodu City is also under the jurisdiction of Shiva.

Originally, the Shiva Sect and the Daning Dynasty were at loggerheads, but as a result, the Great Shang came, and so did the Angel Realm.

Lord Shiva wanted Dashang to help him at the cost of several cities and a girl.

As a result, Dashang and Angel Realm were at loggerheads and had no time to help them.

Lord Shiva wanted to gain something from this war.

But just yesterday, the outskirts of Duodu City collapsed, revealing a mine that had been covered in dust for endless years.

Players with Shiva sect will find the 8th Heavenly BOSS after entering.

The 8th Heavenly BOSS is the most valuable BOSS now.

The Shiva cult wanted to kill it secretly.

But how could such news be kept a secret with such loose management of Shivaism?

The news reached Lin Feng's ears immediately.

Jian Bufan was nearby, and after meeting Lin Feng, they came to Duodu City.

【Boss..Why not call more people?】

After arriving in Duodu City, Jian Bufan found that there were too many people.

Many players who cross the hard country are heading in that direction.

They didn't even hesitate and were discussing the mine.

【no..Is Du Hard Country so devoid of secrets?】

Lin Feng was also dumbfounded: [Ahem, I originally wanted to keep a low profile, but I can't keep a low profile when I cross a hard country.】

[Tsk, tsk, it’s so easy to get intelligence in Du Hard Country!】

[Don’t talk nonsense, let it be leaked..The 8th level BOSS is not that easy to deal with. Let’s explore the path first.】

The 8th Heaven BOSS is the most valuable BOSS, but there are not many people in the world who can beat the 8th Heaven BOSS.

[I don’t know if it’s animal-shaped. If it’s human-shaped, everything is in vain.】

[How could it be humanoid? Humanoids are all staying in the capital of the country.】

【Just go and take a look and you will find out.】

Lin Feng and Jian Bufan, both wearing concealment cloaks, walked toward the mine in the crowd.

The mountains outside Duodu City are all areas around level 50.

Most of the players are at level 50. With such a level, people from Wuyangyang actually want to kill the 8th level.

[There is no other reason why we are crossing the hard country, but there are so many people.】

[That’s right, no matter how strong the BOSS is, we will kill it with human sea tactics, and then give its loot to the Shiva Cult for God’s blessing.】

【Blessed by God.】

Seeing their excitement, I really thought they were here to fight the BOSS.

It wasn't until they entered the mountain range that a level 70 BOSS jumped out and killed them directly.
